The historical alternate path `Away.RISK.Crossing` is rejected.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001::P-B00450-1","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0254","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0255","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0063","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0060","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0062","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0161","disposition":"superseded"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0254","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0257","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HOME-001::HOME-C0003-P-B00120-2","disposition":"elaboration"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Human Ruling ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0063 and MSID Grammar ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0060 jointly establish Away.Crossing as the substantive MSID with operator RISK and world manifestation Highway; parallel MSID entries (0062, 0254, 0257) and the Home register-topology summary corroborate this identity without conflict, while ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0161 documents the explicit rejection of the alternate path Away.RISK.Crossing. The Authorial Grammar and Governing Philosophy passages illustrate and restate the same operator/world-manifestation binding in plain prose.","related_local_ids":["U002"],"unit_local_id":"U001","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0065","M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0124"],"canonical_claim":"Crossing is uniquely forked by Core Species among MEDIAN's Registers: its planning, affordance, movement, and failure grammar diverge by species in a way no other Register does, and while every Register expresses Core-Species bodily logic, Crossing is differentiated to an exceptional degree. This human-confirmed species-branch structure must not be flattened into a generic `Away.Crossing.Species.*` path without adjudication.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0258","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0283","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0065","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0068","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0076","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0124","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0258","disposition":"elaboration"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Human Ruling ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0065 states Crossing is uniquely species-forked among the Registers; MSID Grammar atoms 0068, 0076, 0124, and 0258 and Governing Philosophy atom PA-DIRECT-0283 converge on the same claim of exceptional, non-decorative Core-Species forking, with 0076 adding the explicit constraint against flattening the confirmed branches into a generic species path.","related_local_ids":["U001","U003","U004"],"unit_local_id":"U002","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0064"],"canonical_claim":"Away.Crossing is both a defined semantic unit and the parent branch for Crossing's internal ontology, including `Away.Crossing.Phase` and the Core-Species forks `Away.Crossing.Mouse`, `Away.Crossing.Rabbit`, and `Away.Crossing.Squirrel`.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-HUMAN-RULINGS-001::ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0064","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-MSID-GRAMMAR-001::ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0067","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Human Ruling ATOM-HUMAN-RULINGS-DIRECT-0064 and MSID Grammar ATOM-MSID-DIRECT-0067 both enumerate the same canonical branch roots under Away.Crossing, confirming the taxonomy without conflict.","related_local_ids":["U002"],"unit_local_id":"U003","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0259"],"canonical_claim":"Mouse, Rabbit, and Squirrel bodies do not merely receive modifiers applied to one universal Crossing procedure; each Core Species produces a genuinely distinct procedural grammar of safety, route, timing, and motion, yielding materially different moment-to-moment play contracts that remain branches of a single Register. The same underlying highway simulation is not three worlds — three different bodies make three genuinely different forms of action within it, while every species-specific branch still answers the same constitutional relationship: the party acts through RISK inside immediate Highway danger, commits to a plan, crosses as one undertaking, and receives whole-party resolution with particular consequence attached to particular Citizens.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0259","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0284","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0285","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0291","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0292","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0293","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0024","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Governing Philosophy atoms PA-DIRECT-0259, 0284, 0285, 0291, 0292, and 0293, together with Crossing-spec atom ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0024, converge on one non-conflicting doctrine: species forking produces genuinely distinct play grammars while preserving one Register and one shared constitutional resolution shape.","related_local_ids":["U002","U003"],"unit_local_id":"U004","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0001","M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0256"],"canonical_claim":"Crossing is the Away Register in which the expedition studies the highway through its Core Species body, commits the whole party to one complete plan, and executes that plan as a single continuous run; it is a short, high-attention threshold Register — neither an ordinary Field leg nor a turn-based MEET — where human-scale traffic becomes immediate bodily danger, its complexity residing primarily in perception and planning, followed by irreversible execution and compact resolution. Crossing concerns committed action inside immediate spatial danger — observation, route selection, timing, commitment, motion, refuge, burden, and whole-party consequence — and determines whether the party can pass the defining barrier between territories; a catastrophic result may open MEET, but Crossing itself never acquires turn structure. The dedicated Crossing specification owns its exact phases, execution grammar, adversity, species forks, and tuned procedures.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0256","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-PA-001::ATOM-PA-DIRECT-0261","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0001","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0005","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0006","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0007","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0009","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0011","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0103","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Crossing-source specification.","related_local_ids":["U013","U014"],"unit_local_id":"U005","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0002-B00047-2","M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00280-1"],"canonical_claim":"The proposition.","related_local_ids":["U007"],"unit_local_id":"U006","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00275-1"],"canonical_claim":"Crossing's consequence ladder runs from Cargo Loss (a carried object, food bundle, or Supply abandoned, scattered, or crushed) through Shaken/Fear Memory (a named Condition affecting future volunteering, Crossing posture, or MEET options) to Tharn (an acute shutdown interrupting the sequence, after which rescue or abandonment becomes the only immediate question) and finally Death (rare, explicit, and visible, never generated by an opaque automatic roll or unattended off-screen state); severe disruption at this ladder's upper end may open MEET, and any visible catastrophe remains visible throughout Crossing rather than being concealed.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00271-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00272-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00274-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00274-2","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0009-B00275-1","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0058","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-CROSSING-001::ATOM-CROSS-ACCEPTED-0101","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Away-source MEET.","related_local_ids":["U006"],"unit_local_id":"U007","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0003-B00072-1"],"canonical_claim":"RISK's foundational design purpose is to give the highway a distinct grammar that is brief, embodied, and categorically unlike ordinary travel, turning traffic into immediate bodily commitment. Staging offers deliberately few choices — selecting which edge or crossing site to attempt, redistributing one burdensome cargo item or protective Supply, and setting the party's Crossing posture before committing — and is deliberately not a tactical planning minigame.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0005-M050-SRC-AWAY-001__B00150_dbf494cfc748-1","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0005-M050-SRC-AWAY-001__B00150_dbf494cfc748-2","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0007-B00227-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00230-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00236-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00236-2","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Away-source Return Crossing beat operates in RISK or abbreviated RISK with the burdened party as its mechanical subject, and its persistent change is that the final passage reflects accumulated cost. Return Crossing scales continuously from cinematic to full RISK according to Return Burden: at Low Burden, a short cinematic or abbreviated input sequence delivers relief without pretending the Crossing never existed; at Moderate Burden, a compressed Crossing with fewer windows and one decisive intervention keeps the day's cost legible without full repetition; at High Burden, a full manual Crossing from the far-side post requires the laden, hurt, late, or frightened party to earn the final passage.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0005-M050-SRC-AWAY-001__B00156_e45e981a70e2-1","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0005-M050-SRC-AWAY-001__B00156_e45e981a70e2-2","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0010-B00300-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0010-B00300-2","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0010-B00301-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0010-B00301-2","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0010-B00302-1","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0010-B00302-2","disposition":"supporting"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0025-B00760-2","disposition":"supporting"}],"primary_msid":"Away.Crossing","rationale":"Away-source atoms explicitly mark the 70/20/10 roll as replaced (B00049-1/-2/-3, B00295-1/-2) and the working-position note (C0024-B00728-1) restates the same objective-conditions-over-percentages principle, forming one settled supersession.","related_local_ids":["U011"],"unit_local_id":"U012","unit_status":"reconciled"},{"authority_basis_atom_keys":["M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00241-1","M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00243-1"],"canonical_claim":"Crossing is MEDIAN's immediate bodily danger Register, converting the highway from ecological boundary into lived panic — speed, noise, gaps, fumes, lane width, interrupted sight, and the need to keep moving after commitment. As RISK, it is a brief, real-time or tightly time-stepped sequence in which the party reads traffic windows, commits to transverse movement, and absorbs individual consequences when bodies, load, weather, and timing exceed the available passage; RISK has no Approach strip, negotiation round, initiative order, targeting, or tactical positioning grid, and its interface must not show these or a turn order, enemy health, or exact Exposure meter. Its decisions are spatial and immediate — wait, commit, advance, hold at a refuge, retreat while still possible, protect another Citizen, release cargo, or recover from separation. As canon: RISK handles highway-scale immediate danger, and Crossing may create personal Exposure and consequence but never uses the Away MEET Approach strip — a Crossing can alter individual Exposure, cargo, fear, wound, or time without ever opening an Approach strip.","human_question":null,"members":[{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00241-1","disposition":"basis"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001::AWAY-C0008-B00241-2","disposition":"elaboration"},{"atom_key":"M050-SRC-AWAY-001
